caption:
Six brokers. Official trade APIs. One server-side kill switch.

KaatDo operates as a server-side kill switch across six supported brokers: Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan, and Groww. Monitoring and execution run on official trade APIs.

When a rule breaches, KaatDo cancels every pending order, squares off every position at market, and locks the account until close, re-firing if trading activity reappears.
